title: Eval
subtitle: Score the real harness/runtime. Each case binds one eval session and reuses Session Observation.
isolationNote: Each run first creates a business-named parent workspace (e.g. Eval-OfficeTasks-date-shortId). Cases run production AgentEngine in child folders and write the same Observation JSONL as real sessions (session_kind=eval). Conversation shells project thinking / tool calls / replies plus token usage so the chat page shows a real process rail and credits. Use Office tasks for office KPIs, Agent workflows for multi-step agent KPIs, and Aider Polyglot / ClassEval for coding-agent KPIs. MCP, browser, computer-use, and web search stay off. One run at a time.
developerModeRequired: Turn on Developer Mode in Settings → System to use evals.
observationEmpty: No session observation yet (case has no conversation_id)

form.modelSelectTooltip: Model used by the live eval harness. Default uses the first enabled chat model.
form.modelUnavailableHint: This saved model is no longer available. Choose another model or Default Model.
